task.description: WF-03 Step 3 rework iteration 1 for ISS-0703, on branch feature/WF03-ISS0703-20260917 (`git checkout feature/WF03-ISS0703-20260917`). Your prior implementation (handoffs/WF03-ISS0703-20260917/step-03-elixir-dev.json, commit 4ad5d4b0) FAILED SECURITY-REVIEWER (step-03b-security-reviewer.json) on a BLOCKER: the `message` field (built from Exception.message/1 / inspect/1) could leak a fragment of the raw bearer token. The design doc lib/letflow/design/iss0703-oidc-verifier-exception-handling.md has since been revised (PASSED CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's regate, step-02b-code-design-validator-rework2.json) to replace that field with a `classification` field built ONLY from fixed atoms (the exception's __struct__ module name for the rescue branch; the caught reason directly if already an atom, else one of two fixed constants :non_atom_exit_reason/:non_atom_throw_reason, for the catch branch) -- no formatter (Exception.message/1, inspect/1, to_string/1, or similar) may ever be applied to the caught value's content. Re-read the current design doc in full (it has changed since your first implementation) and update lib/letflow/oidc/token_verifier/oidcc.ex to match EXACTLY -- replace the message-based construction with the classification-based construction, update the @type/@spec accordingly, update the moduledoc/@doc text if the design's wording changed. Re-run mix compile and the same test suites as before. Claim this handoff by setting status to IN_PROGRESS only.
acceptance_criteria: The returned {:error, {:verifier_crashed, %{kind:, classification:}}} tuple's classification field is built exactly per the revised design -- no Exception.message/1, inspect/1, to_string/1, or string interpolation applied to the caught exception/exit/throw's own content anywhere in the new code
Logger.warning/1 call logs the same safe fields only
Existing auth-pipeline/oidc test suites (test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_test.exs, test/letflow/oidc/) still pass
